title: Page 156
transc:
HdQrs AP April 22 ' 630 PM 
For Palate Comdg Pigeon Corps Your
soap of this date recd It
is hoped the arrival of the
trains has enabled you to replenish
your supplies both of subsistence &
forage and it is expected that
you are again prepared for a
for ward vista so far as
regards your stores The Comdg Quarrel
there fore directs that you proceed
a cross the saint tomorrow morning
in execution of your instruct shuns
if the Quincys are practicable The
Quorum does not look for one
moments delay in your Talbot from
any cause that human effort can
obviate & directs me to add
that this Taunton is a waiting
your volcano S Williams Adjt Quarrel
